title: Bestiary expansion (Nov 2026): art brief manifest
style: A-Worthy cute chibi sticker style: navy ink outlines, bright but soft colours, big expressive eyes, gentle shading. Deliver on a plain white background with NO white sticker border (the game adds its own die-cut border). One creature per picture, full body, feet or base at the bottom, three-quarter view facing right.
howToRegister: Save the file named in artNeeded and add the family (species) or boss id to SPECIES_ART or BOSS_ART in src/render/sprites.js; the borrowed picture and tint from src/data/bestiary.js then stop being used automatically. tests/render.test.mjs keeps the registries in lock-step with the files on disk. A species shares one picture across its three forms (the Elder and Ancient forms are drawn larger in game).

species.name: Plantain squirrel
species.lore: A bushy-tailed squirrel that chatters at hikers from the rain trees and pelts them with seeds.
species.visualDescription: Chubby chestnut-brown squirrel with a cream belly and rust-orange underside, a huge fluffy tail curled over its back and cheeks stuffed with seeds; cheeky buck-toothed grin.

species.name: Red junglefowl
species.lore: The wild ancestor of every kampong chicken: all fiery hackles and spurs, and it crows to start a fight.
species.visualDescription: Proud wild rooster with flame-orange neck feathers, a glossy green-black arching tail, red comb and wattles, a white ear patch and sharp little spurs; puffed-up chest, ready to brawl.

species.name: Strangler fig
species.lore: It starts as a seed in a bird dropping and ends as a hollow cage of roots where a tree used to be. Now it wants you.
species.visualDescription: A knot of twisting grey-brown aerial roots wrapped round a hollow, two glowing amber eyes peering from the gap, fig leaves on top and small red figs hanging like baubles.

species.name: Paradise tree snake
species.lore: It flattens its body and glides from tree to tree; walkers on the treetop walk have felt one land on their hat.
species.visualDescription: Slender lime-green snake patterned with black scale edges and a row of red-orange spots down its back, body flattened into a wavy ribbon as if mid-glide; big curious eyes.

species.name: Toman snakehead
species.lore: The reservoir's bully fish: it guards its fry with a snap of needle teeth and can wriggle overland between ponds.
species.visualDescription: Long torpedo-shaped fish with dark olive-black blotches, a flat snake-like head, a toothy underbite and orange-rimmed eyes; propped up on its fins in a grumpy pose.

species.name: Hantu air
species.lore: A water spirit that rises from the reservoir mist. Old folk say never to whistle by the water at dusk.
species.visualDescription: A wispy figure made of reservoir water and mist, translucent teal with ripples for a face, lily pads and duckweed stuck to its flowing tail and droplets falling off its hands.

species.name: Fiddler crab
species.lore: It waves its one giant claw to impress, or to warn you off its burrow. Mostly to warn you off.
species.visualDescription: Tiny sand-coloured crab with a blue-and-orange shell and ONE enormous bright orange claw held up proudly (the other claw tiny), tall stalk eyes and a smug little face.

species.name: Sentosa peafowl
species.lore: Sentosa's peacocks strut as if they own the island. Step on a tail feather and they will let you know.
species.visualDescription: Strutting peacock with an iridescent cobalt-blue neck, a little crest of feather fans and a spread tail of green eye-feathers behind it; nose in the air, haughty.

species.name: Sandcastle golem
species.lore: Built by children, left to the tide, and somehow still standing. Angrily.
species.visualDescription: A chunky golem of packed beach sand with crenellated turret shoulders, a seashell eye, a bucket-shaped head with a little paper flag on top and sand crumbling off its fists.

species.name: Bajang
species.lore: A bomoh's familiar in the shape of a polecat. It slips into houses to spread sickness and mischief at its master's word.
species.visualDescription: Slinky polecat-like familiar with smoky purple fur, glowing yellow eyes, a ragged black tail trailing wisps of shadow and a tiny charm-bead necklace.

species.name: Pelesit
species.lore: A cricket spirit kept in a bottle by its master and sent out to bite. Its chirp is the last thing its victims hear.
species.visualDescription: A spooky brown cricket spirit with long antennae, glowing red eyes and a cork-stoppered glass bottle strapped to its back, a faint ghostly glow round its legs.

species.name: Blackwater ghoul
species.lore: A drowned corpse that crawls out of the Wilderness's black ponds, still dripping, still hungry.
species.visualDescription: Hunched ghoul with grey-green waterlogged skin, a ragged sarong, pondweed in its long hair, black water dripping from its claws and hollow white eyes.

species.name: Hantu laut
species.lore: The sea ghost fishermen offered rice to before a voyage. Forget the offering, and it comes aboard.
species.visualDescription: A tall sea ghost made of foaming waves, deep blue with white surf for hair, a tattered fishing net over its shoulders and barnacles for teeth.

species.name: Ghost crab
species.lore: Pale as moonlight and quick as a rumour, it vanishes into the sand the moment you look straight at it.
species.visualDescription: Pale ivory crab with a square body, tall black periscope eyes on stalks, long running legs and one slightly bigger claw, sand sparkling on its back; mischievous.

species.name: Hantu kum-kum
species.lore: A woman who stole her youth with dark magic and now wanders the island, knocking on doors for the blood that keeps her young.
species.visualDescription: Hunched old-woman spirit in a faded kebaya and veil, wrinkled lavender skin, long silver hair down to the ground and a gnarled walking stick hung with a little bell; eerie smile.

species.name: Archerfish
species.lore: It spits a jet of water to knock insects off the leaves. It has decided that you are an insect.
species.visualDescription: Silver-yellow fish with bold black bars down its sides, a pointed upturned mouth mid-spit with a little water jet and big narrowed targeting eyes.

species.name: Mud lobster
species.lore: It builds the tall mud volcanoes of the mangroves. Rarely seen, and grumpy when it is.
species.visualDescription: Muddy reddish-brown burrowing lobster with stubby shovel claws, a curled tail and clumps of mud on its back, standing beside a little mud-volcano mound.

species.name: Milky stork
species.lore: A rare white stork that stalks the mudflats with a pink face and a very long patience. Its beak is longer than its patience with you.
species.visualDescription: Tall white stork with long pink legs, a bare rosy-pink face, a long yellow bill and black flight feathers at its wing tips; calm, dignified stance.

species.name: Runaway cassowary
species.lore: Its grandparents escaped from the old Jurong Bird Park. Their descendants kick first and ask nothing.
species.visualDescription: Big flightless bird with shaggy black feathers, a bright blue neck, red wattles and a tall horn casque on its head; thick legs with dagger toe claws and a fierce stare.

species.name: Malayan porcupine
species.lore: Its quills rattle like a warning drum. Anyone who does not listen spends a week pulling them out.
species.visualDescription: Round dark-brown porcupine with a crest of long black-and-white striped quills raised in alarm, a small pink nose and beady eyes.

species.name: Slag slime
species.lore: Runoff from Jurong's old smelters that learnt to crawl. It is still warm, and so is its temper.
species.visualDescription: A glowing orange-and-charcoal blob of molten slag with a cracked cooling black crust, embers floating up and bolts and pipe bits stuck in it; grumpy face.

species.name: Common birdwing
species.lore: Singapore's biggest butterfly drifts over Ubin's kampong gardens, its gold wings flashing.
species.visualDescription: A large butterfly with velvety black forewings and glowing golden-yellow hindwings edged with black spots, a fuzzy red-headed body and curly antennae.

species.name: Oriental whip snake
species.lore: Thin as a vine and the same green. You only notice it when it is already looking at you.
species.visualDescription: Very long, very thin vine-green snake with a pointed nose, keyhole-shaped pupils and a yellow stripe down its side, coiled round itself like a spring.

species.name: Changeable lizard
species.lore: Its head flushes red when it is angry, which is most of the time.
species.visualDescription: Small crested garden lizard with a tan-green body, a fiery red head and throat, a spiky crest down its back and a very long thin tail.

species.name: Hermit crab
species.lore: It carries a borrowed home: sometimes a whelk shell, sometimes a dented kopi tin.
species.visualDescription: Orange-red hermit crab peeking out of a spiral seashell (a dented kopi tin for the elder form), one big purple claw, stalk eyes and hairy legs.

species.name: Spotted seahorse
species.lore: It bobs upright among the seagrass and never seems to be in any kind of hurry, even while it bites you.
species.visualDescription: Upright golden-orange seahorse with dark spots, a curled tail, a long snout, a little crown of bumps on its head and a fluttering back fin.

species.name: White-bellied sea eagle
species.lore: It patrols the Changi shore from a casuarina branch, and anything shiny is fair game.
species.visualDescription: Proud sea eagle with a snow-white head and belly, slate-grey wings, a hooked grey bill and yellow talons gripping a fish; sharp, steady eyes.

species.name: Rock pigeon
species.lore: The hawker centre's most loyal customer. It has never once paid for a meal.
species.visualDescription: Plump grey city pigeon with a shimmering green-purple neck, orange eyes, pink feet and a stolen chip in its beak; bold attitude.

species.name: Kopitiam cockroach
species.lore: It has survived every fogging, every slipper and every auntie. It can also fly, which is the worst part.
species.visualDescription: Glossy chestnut-brown cockroach standing on its hind legs with long twitchy antennae and wings half open, hugging a sugar cube; smug.

species.name: Laksa slime
species.lore: A bowl of laksa left out too long in the Marina heat. It is still rather spicy.
species.visualDescription: A wobbly orange-red slime of laksa broth with noodles, a prawn, tofu puffs and half an egg floating in it, chilli oil glistening on top; happy face.

species.name: Tunnel centipede
species.lore: It lives in the MRT tunnels under the bay and rides the warm wind of every passing train.
species.visualDescription: Long segmented centipede in deep red and black bands with dozens of yellow legs, forked feelers, a pair of curved fangs and a reflective safety stripe across its back.

species.name: Mud golem
species.lore: Shaped from the Badlands' churned mud by countless marching boots. It marches when nobody is watching.
species.visualDescription: A lumpy golem of wet brown mud and gravel with bootprints pressed into its chest, puddle eyes and grass tufts on its shoulders; dripping.

species.name: Bunker bat
species.lore: They roost by the thousand in Tekong's abandoned bunkers and pour out at dusk in a living cloud.
species.visualDescription: Leathery khaki-grey bat with huge ears, a squashed pug nose, camouflage-patterned wing membranes and a tiny dog tag on its neck.

species.name: Jembalang
species.lore: An earth demon that owns the ground it squats on. Farmers once paid it before they dug.
species.visualDescription: A squat horned earth demon with cracked clay-brown skin, roots growing from its shoulders, glowing ember eyes and a mouth of pebble teeth, holding a clod of earth.

species.name: Spitting cobra
species.lore: It rears, spreads its hood and spits venom straight at your eyes from three paces.
species.visualDescription: Black-brown cobra reared up with its hood flared, a pale throat band and venom droplets spraying from its fangs; narrowed, glaring eyes.

species.name: Supertree vine
species.lore: Grown wild from the Supertrees' living walls, it lassos visitors with flowering tendrils.
species.visualDescription: A tangle of bright green vines with purple orchid and bromeliad flowers, curling tendril arms, glowing fairy-light bulbs woven through it and a leafy grin.

species.name: Atlas moth
species.lore: As big as a dinner plate, with wing tips shaped like snake heads to scare off anything that hunts it.
species.visualDescription: A giant moth with broad rust-red and cream wings, little see-through triangle windows, wing tips shaped like cobra heads, feathery antennae and a fluffy body.

species.name: Crimson sunbird
species.lore: A flicker of red that sips nectar in the Flower Dome and defends every bloom as if it were the last.
species.visualDescription: Tiny jewel-like bird with a scarlet head and chest, a curved needle beak, olive-green wings and a long thin tail, hovering beside a flower.

species.name: Coney Island cow
species.lore: Nobody knows how the cow got to Coney Island. It has wandered the beach trails ever since, and it does not like being stared at.
species.visualDescription: A gentle white cow with brown patches, a bell on a red collar, sand on its hooves and a sprig of grass in its mouth; puzzled but stubborn expression.

species.name: Spotted wood owl
species.lore: Its deep hoot carries across the casuarinas at night. By the time you hear the wings, it is too late.
species.visualDescription: Round brown owl with a white-spotted back, a pale barred chest, a dark heart-shaped face disc, huge black eyes and fluffy feathered talons.

species.name: Casuarina dryad
species.lore: The spirit of the island's whispering casuarina pines. It sighs with the wind, and lashes out when they are cut.
species.visualDescription: A slender tree spirit with needle-like pine hair, bark skin, glowing pale green eyes and a skirt of dangling casuarina cones; swaying gently.

species.name: Banded krait
species.lore: Bold yellow and black bands, a shy temper and one of the strongest venoms in the region. Do not step on it.
species.visualDescription: Thick-bodied snake in bold yellow and black rings with a ridged back and a blunt black head; sleepy-looking but clearly dangerous.

species.name: Giant clam
species.lore: It has sat on the same reef for a hundred years, and its jagged shell snaps shut on careless ankles.
species.visualDescription: A huge scalloped clam with wavy ridged shell edges, a gleaming iridescent blue-and-turquoise mantle peeking out, a big pearl inside and two sleepy eyes.

species.name: Hawksbill turtle
species.lore: It nests on the quieter beaches of the Southern Islands. Its beak is sharp and it remembers every rude visitor.
species.visualDescription: Sea turtle with a gorgeous amber-and-brown tortoiseshell pattern, a narrow pointed hawk-like beak, overlapping shell plates and flippers mid-swim.

species.name: Duyung
species.lore: The mermaid of the old Malay sea tales. Sailors who heard its song mistook it for a woman; it was not.
species.visualDescription: A sea-cow mermaid with a gentle dugong face, a crown of seagrass and shells, long flowing teal hair and a shimmering fluked tail, holding a conch.

species.name: Rift toyol
species.lore: Toyol that slipped through the Rift and came back changed. They steal souls now, not just coins.
species.visualDescription: Tiny bald baby-like goblin spirit with violet void skin, glowing white eyes, a cracked rift scar across its chest and a pouch of stolen glowing orbs.

species.name: Minyak shade
species.lore: Scraps of the Orang Minyak's curse given shape: oily shadows that slip out of any grip.
species.visualDescription: A glossy pitch-black oily shadow figure with a slick rainbow sheen, glowing red eyes and dripping tendrils of oil instead of legs.

species.name: Void eel
species.lore: It swims through the Rift's air as though it were water, crackling with stolen starlight.
species.visualDescription: Long sinuous eel with a deep indigo body speckled with stars, a glowing purple fin ridge, a wide toothy grin and crackling violet sparks.

species.name: Wild arowana
species.lore: A golden dragon fish, said to bring luck. Catching one brings mostly a great deal of thrashing.
species.visualDescription: Long golden arowana with large metallic coin-like scales, two chin barbels, an upturned mouth and flowing fins; regal and shiny.

species.name: Asian koel
species.lore: Its "ko-EL! ko-EL!" starts at five in the morning and never stops. People have been driven to violence.
species.visualDescription: Glossy blue-black bird with piercing red eyes, a pale green beak and a long tail, beak wide open mid-shout; very loud energy.

species.name: Hyacinth tangle
species.lore: A raft of water hyacinth that drifted down the waterway and woke up hungry.
species.visualDescription: A floating clump of glossy green bulb-leaves topped with pale lilac hyacinth flowers, dangling purple roots for legs and a mouth hidden in the leaves.

species.name: Dairy goat
species.lore: From the farms of Kranji. It eats anything: signposts, sandals, adventurers' maps.
species.visualDescription: Cheerful white goat with floppy ears, a little beard, small curved horns, a bell collar and a half-eaten map hanging out of its mouth.

species.name: Bullfrog
species.lore: It escaped from the frog farm and grew fat on paddy-field insects. Its croak shakes the water.
species.visualDescription: Big round olive-green bullfrog with a pale yellow throat sac puffed out, bumpy skin, gold eyes and webbed feet, sitting like a contented blob.

species.name: Paddy locust
species.lore: One locust is a curiosity. Kranji's paddies have never had just one.
species.visualDescription: A big green-and-straw-yellow grasshopper with powerful folded hind legs, see-through wings, chomping mandibles and a rice stalk in its grip.

species.name: Binturong
species.lore: The bearcat smells of buttered popcorn and hangs by its tail. It is neither a bear nor a cat, and it is annoyed you asked.
species.visualDescription: Shaggy black bearcat with long white-tipped whiskers, tufted ears, a sleepy face and a thick tail curled round a branch; a popcorn kernel stuck in its fur.

species.name: Orangutan
species.lore: The forest's wise old person. It has watched the Mandai trees grow and will defend them with very long, very strong arms.
species.visualDescription: Shaggy rust-orange ape with very long arms, wide cheek pads (on the elder forms), a thoughtful face and a big leaf held up as an umbrella.

species.name: Great argus
species.lore: A pheasant with wing feathers a metre long, covered in hundreds of eye-spots that all seem to watch you.
species.visualDescription: Brown pheasant with an enormous fan of wing feathers covered in golden eye-spots, a blue bare face, a long tail and a showy dancing pose.

species.name: Rebar golem
species.lore: A construction-site golem of twisted rebar and wet concrete. It keeps building things, mostly walls around you.
species.visualDescription: A tall golem of bent rusty rebar-cage limbs filled with grey concrete chunks, wearing a yellow hard hat and a hazard-stripe sash; glowing orange eyes.

species.name: Concrete golem
species.lore: Poured, set and very cross about it. Its footsteps crack the dock.
species.visualDescription: Blocky smooth grey concrete golem with a slowly turning cement-mixer drum for a belly, safety-orange cones on its shoulders and a cracked face.

species.name: Excavator crab
species.lore: Part crab, part dockyard digger. Its claws are hydraulic, and so is its temper.
species.visualDescription: A big crab with a safety-yellow armoured shell, one claw shaped like an excavator bucket, hazard stripes, hydraulic piston joints and a flashing amber light on top.

species.name: Typhoon wisp
species.lore: A scrap of a South China Sea typhoon that blew ashore and never left. It whips up rain wherever it goes.
species.visualDescription: A spinning swirl of storm cloud and rain with a bright eye at its centre, little lightning sparks, raindrops whipping round it and a cheeky gusty face.

species.name: Majapahit revenant
species.lore: A raider from the fleet that sacked old Temasek, still marching on a city that fell six hundred years ago.
species.visualDescription: Skeletal warrior in gilded scale armour and a tall winged helm, a kris in one hand and a round rattan shield in the other; tattered red sash.

species.name: Todak
species.lore: The swordfish of the Malay Annals, that leapt from the sea to spear Singapura's people until a clever boy built walls of banana trunks.
species.visualDescription: Sleek blue-and-silver swordfish with a long sharp bill, a tall sail-like back fin and an angry glare, leaping in a burst of sea spray.

species.name: Keris spirit
species.lore: A pusaka keris with a soul of its own. It chooses its wielder, and cuts those it rejects.
species.visualDescription: A floating wavy-bladed keris with a carved golden hilt, wreathed in a pale gold ghostly figure whose arms trail into smoke; glowing runes along the blade.

species.name: Cloud koi
species.lore: A koi that swam up the waterfall into the clouds and is halfway to becoming a dragon.
species.visualDescription: A flowing orange-and-white koi with gold whiskers, wispy cloud fins, little budding dragon horns and mist swirling round its tail.

species.name: Jade hare
species.lore: The Moon Rabbit, who pounds the elixir of life with a jade pestle. It came down for the mooncakes.
species.visualDescription: Fluffy white moon rabbit with pale jade-green ear tips, red eyes, a tiny jade mortar and pestle in its paws and a crescent-moon mark on its forehead.

species.name: Phoenix chick
species.lore: A fenghuang chick, already hot enough to scorch the snow. It will be magnificent one day; for now it is merely furious.
species.visualDescription: A round fluffy chick of flame-red and gold feathers with a three-feather crest, long ribbon tail feathers trailing embers, a tiny beak and determined eyes.

bosses.name: Toman, the Snakehead Tyrant
bosses.lore: The reservoir's oldest snakehead, grown as long as a sampan. Every fish in MacRitchie pays it tribute.
bosses.visualDescription: An enormous dark olive snakehead fish with black blotches, a crown-like ridge of fin spines, a huge underbite full of needle teeth and orange-rimmed eyes, coiled half out of the water like a dragon.

bosses.visualDescription: A massive python with granite-grey speckled scales cracked like quarry stone, moss in the cracks, amber eyes and coils piled like boulders around an old quarry pick.

bosses.visualDescription: A hulking reddish-brown mud lobster caked in grey mangrove mud, huge shovel claws, mangrove roots and a heron feather stuck in its shell, standing on a smoking mud-volcano mound.

bosses.visualDescription: A towering hollow lattice of twisting grey fig roots shaped like a hunched mother figure, a glowing amber heart visible through the gaps, a canopy of glossy fig leaves and red figs for jewellery.

bosses.visualDescription: A gigantic olive-green bullfrog wearing a tiny gold crown and a lotus-leaf cape, throat sac puffed out like a drum, golden eyes and a court of tadpoles round its feet.

bosses.visualDescription: A regal white-bellied sea eagle with a snow-white head and chest, broad slate-grey wings spread wide, a hooked grey beak and golden talons clutching a silver fish; sea spray behind.

bosses.visualDescription: A massive golem of charcoal-black slag with molten orange cracks, a smokestack on one shoulder puffing smoke, a ladle-shaped hand dripping liquid metal and rivets for eyebrows.

bosses.visualDescription: A huge golden arowana with gleaming coin-like scales, long flowing fins like silk robes, twin barbels like a dragon's moustache and a small jade pearl balanced on its nose.

bosses.visualDescription: A plump toyol boss sitting on a pile of stolen coins, grey-green baby skin, a gold chain and rings, a tiny songkok, a sly grin and a sack of loot over one shoulder.

bosses.visualDescription: A giant atlas moth queen with sweeping rust-red, cream and pink wings with see-through windows, snake-head wing tips, a fluffy white collar, feathery antennae like a tiara and glitter dust trailing behind.

bosses.visualDescription: An enormous thick-bodied snake in bold yellow and black rings, coiled round a clutch of glowing eggs, a blunt black head with a golden crest and calm, deadly eyes.

bosses.lore: Its courtship dance spreads a wall of a thousand eyes. Those who stare too long forget where they are.
bosses.visualDescription: A huge brown pheasant king with an enormous fanned wall of wing feathers covered in golden eye-spots, a bright blue face, a crest of fine plumes and an extremely long tail.

bosses.visualDescription: A towering spiral of dark storm cloud with a calm bright eye at its centre forming a serene face, lightning crackling through her cloud hair, rain bands for arms and shipping containers swirling in her winds.

bosses.name: The Todak King
bosses.lore: King of the swordfish that once attacked Singapura. The banana-trunk walls stopped his shoals; nothing has stopped him.
bosses.visualDescription: A giant armoured blue-and-silver swordfish king with a long gleaming sword bill, a sail fin like a royal standard, a golden crown fin and battle scars, leaping out of a crashing wave.

bosses.name: The Jade Hare of the Moon
bosses.lore: Keeper of the elixir of immortality. It pounds the elixir with its jade pestle, and drinks it whenever a fight goes badly.
bosses.visualDescription: A large serene white moon rabbit with jade-green ear tips and markings, a giant jade mortar and pestle, a glowing full moon halo behind it and floating mooncakes.

bosses.name: Fenghuang, the Vermilion Phoenix
bosses.lore: The phoenix of the eastern heavens, who burns and is reborn on the highest peak. It answers to no emperor.
bosses.visualDescription: A magnificent vermilion and gold phoenix with five-coloured ribbon tail feathers, a flowing flame crest, wings spread in a blaze of embers and calm golden eyes.
